items.title: Denim Tears FW26 Collection Unveiled
items.summary: Denim Tears has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, honoring André Leon Talley. This is a new designer collection drop that aligns with your client's interest in limited-edition streetwear and collaborations.

items.title: Tickets for Sephora's Inaugural UK Beauty Festival Go On Sale Soon
items.summary: Sephoria Europe is coming to London for the first time on October 17-18, 2026, offering immersive masterclasses and product giveaways. MySephora Gold Members can grab tickets on August 18, with general public sales starting August 20.
items.date_info: Gold Member tickets on sale Tue 18 Aug, 9am BST; General tickets on sale Thu 20 Aug, 9am BST

items.title: Legendary Blue Note Jazz Club to Open First London Venue This Autumn
items.summary: The iconic Blue Note Jazz Club will open its first UK location in London's West End on September 23, featuring acts like Robert Glasper and Erykah Badu. Tickets for the opening season go on general sale next week.
items.date_info: General tickets on sale Fri 14 Aug, 10am BST (presales Aug 12-13)

items.title: FRUIT OF THE LOOM x Keiji Kaneko 'Athletic Formal Suit' is Back
items.summary: The previously sold-out 100% cotton 'Athletic Formal Suit' from the Fruit of the Loom Japan x Keiji Kaneko collaboration is back, now including a new warmer brown option for Fall/Winter.

items.title: PORTER Unveils New 'Bounce' Series Bags
items.summary: PORTER's first new bag series in over a year, the 'Bounce' collection, features five pieces constructed with glossy nylon and breathable Cubic Eye contact panels, designed to spring back into shape.

items.title: Transparent SYITREN RM1 CD Player Now on Kickstarter
items.summary: A visually striking transparent CD player, the SYITREN RM1, is available for pre-order on Kickstarter. It showcases the spinning disc and internal mechanics, turning album playback into kinetic art.
items.date_info: Available for pre-order on Kickstarter (shipping Oct 2026)

items.title: New West African Bar 'Asase' Opening in Shoreditch This Autumn
items.summary: Award-winning bartender Emanuele 'Lele' Mensah is set to open Asase, a new West African-inspired cocktail bar in Shoreditch this autumn, promising unique drinks like an egusi soup-inspired martini.

items.title: Blue Note Jazz Club London: Tickets on Sale Next Week for Grand Opening Season
items.summary: The legendary Blue Note Jazz Club is opening its first London venue in Covent Garden on September 23rd, with a star-studded opening season. Tickets go on presale for Blue Note Members on August 12th, followed by a venue presale on August 13th, and general sale on August 14th.
items.date_info: Blue Note Membership presale Aug 12, 10am; Venue presale Aug 13, 10am; General sale Aug 14, 10am BST

items.title: Sephoria Europe UK Beauty Festival Tickets Go On Sale Soon
items.summary: Sephora's immersive beauty festival, Sephoria Europe, is coming to London on October 17-18. MySephora Gold Members can grab tickets on August 18th, with general admission tickets following on August 20th.
items.date_info: MySephora Gold Member tickets Aug 18, 9am BST; General admission tickets Aug 20, 9am BST

items.title: Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors FC x DARKRUM 'TIME OF PIONEER' Collection Drops Today
items.summary: For football and streetwear fans, the limited-edition 'TIME OF PIONEER' collection from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors FC and DARKRUM is released today on Musinsa.

items.title: Rock The Runway London Tickets On Sale Now
items.summary: Tickets are now available for 'Rock The Runway London', a new event in the capital. Secure your spot for this exciting London experience.

items.title: Tiny Vinyl Player Spins Four-Inch Records
items.summary: Discover this clever new gadget: a miniature turntable designed to play four-inch vinyl records. A perfect blend of nostalgic charm and innovative design.

items.title: Water Glasses Turn Into Colorful Frameless Eyewear
items.summary: Check out these beautifully designed 'water glasses' that transform into colorful frameless eyewear, blurring the lines between functional object and wearable art.

items.title: KIDILL x UMBRO "Wizard" FW26 Track Suit Drops Today
items.summary: The limited-edition "Wizard" Fall/Winter 2026 track jacket and pants from the KIDILL x UMBRO collaboration, featuring over 40 adjusters and tarot-inspired artwork, are available starting today. This is a perfect streetwear drop, not trainers, with immediate actionability.

items.title: EVANGELION:95's First FW26 Drop of Faux-Vintage Tees Now Available
items.summary: EVANGELION:95 has released its first Fall/Winter 2026 collection of five graphic T-shirts, translating iconic anime moments into faux-vintage 1995 apparel. This limited-edition streetwear drop is available now and is a great catch for fans.

items.title: Barbican Conservatory Offering Free Plant Cuttings
items.summary: Londoners can get free plant cuttings from the Barbican Conservatory's collection of over 2,000 species ahead of its closure for restoration. Booking for the first plant adoption event opens on Wednesday, August 19, offering a unique and valuable free perk.
items.date_info: Booking opens Wednesday, August 19, 2026 (first event same day, further dates Sept 13 & Dec 2)

items.title: Bold Tendencies Peckham Rooftop Festival 'Euphoria' with Multi-Story Orchestra Tickets
items.summary: South London's iconic Bold Tendencies rooftop art gallery is hosting its 20th-anniversary culture festival, 'Euphoria,' featuring visual arts, live music, and performances. Tickets are available for upcoming events, including The Multi Story Orchestra's 'Dreamer' on August 13 and 14.

items.title: Fallout Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V Overseer's Edition Replica Pre-Orders Live
items.summary: A 1:1 die-cast replica of the Fallout Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V Overseer's Edition, as seen in the TV series, is now available for pre-order. This limited-edition collectible features in-universe animations and an FM radio, shipping in November 2026.

items.title: Seiko 'Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches' Exhibition in London
items.summary: Seiko's Power Design Project exhibition, showcasing experimental concept watches, returns to Japan House London. This free exhibition offers a unique look into innovative watch design and runs from August 27 to September 15.
items.date_info: Opens Thursday, August 27, 2026, runs until September 15, 2026

items.title: England vs Spain Wembley Tickets General Sale
items.summary: Tickets for the UEFA Nations League match between England and Spain at Wembley Stadium go on general sale this Thursday. This is a major London football event that is likely to sell out quickly.
items.date_info: General sale begins Thursday, August 13, 2026, 12 PM BST

items.title: Yoshida & Co. 90th Anniversary Book
items.summary: Celebrating 90 years, Yoshida & Co. (makers of PORTER bags) is releasing a commemorative book bound with the same thread as their bags, using traditional Japanese techniques. This is a beautifully designed, limited-edition object for collectors.

items.title: LEGO Harry Potter Ministry of Magic Collectors' Edition
items.summary: A massive new 3,491-piece LEGO Harry Potter set recreating the Ministry of Magic is being released. It's a highly detailed collector's item, offering early access for LEGO Insiders before its general release.
items.date_info: LEGO Insiders early access from August 29, 2026; general release September 1, 2026

items.title: Colonel Saab Kebab Festival in Trafalgar Square
items.summary: Colonel Saab in Trafalgar Square is hosting a month-long luxury Kebab Festival, offering a special menu showcasing elevated Indian kebabs. It's a unique food event running every Monday to Saturday.

items.title: New Immersive Arcade Arena Opening in South London
items.summary: Step into a massive new neon arcade on London's South Bank featuring real-life PAC-MAN, electric karting (Chaos Karts), and a brand-new Alien Invasion drone experience. Tickets are on sale now for its September 5 opening, perfect for a unique immersive experience near you.
items.date_info: Opens Saturday 5 September 2026, tickets on sale now

items.title: The Golden Hinde Transforms into a Free Floating Pub
items.summary: London's historic Golden Hinde ship in Southwark is hosting 'Thirsty Thursdays', transforming into a floating pub with free entry and great-value drinks in SE1. No booking is required, just show up and explore the historic galleon while you sip. The next event is on August 20th.
items.date_info: Every Thursday from August 20 to September 24, 5:30 PM - 10:00 PM

items.title: weber 'Girl With a Pearl Earring' T-shirt Drop
items.summary: Japanese brand weber is releasing a unique, limited-edition T-shirt featuring Johannes Vermeer's 'Girl With a Pearl Earring'. The design is meticulously rendered with an 11-screen silkscreen process on a washed, vintage-style 1990s body, launching tomorrow on their online store.

items.title: Fear of God Essentials x Dallas Cowboys Training Camp Collection
items.summary: Jerry Lorenzo's Fear of God Essentials has launched a new Training Camp collection with the Dallas Cowboys. This limited-edition streetwear capsule features premium, oversized hoodies, graphic tees, and headwear, blending classic Cowboys branding with Fear of God's signature aesthetic. Items are available now but are expected to sell out quickly.
